faqs.q: Which cities in New Brunswick should I target first?
faqs.a: Start with the places you already serve and can describe distinctly, often around Moncton, Saint John and Fredericton. Pages for areas you genuinely cover rank faster and convert better than a page that claims the whole province.

faqs.q: Do I need a separate page for each city I serve in New Brunswick?
faqs.a: If you genuinely serve more than one city and can describe each one distinctly, separate pages help, because people search with a city name attached. Copied pages that only swap the place name tend to hurt more than help.

faqs.q: Does regulation in New Brunswick affect my website wording?
faqs.a: It can. Rules about titles and advertising vary by province and profession, so your site should use only the claims and credentials you are entitled to, and explain them clearly to clients.
